newsitem.title: USA: Chantal dissidents say will support co.
newsitem.headline: Chantal dissidents say will support co.

text.p: Former Chantal Pharmaceutical Corp dissidents Donald Wright and Francis Phalen said Wednesday they will support the company's current management team and dissolve their dissident group.
In a statement, they said they have "complete confidence" in the current management group based on positive talks.

They said they have concluded it is in the best interest of the stockholders to resolve their differences with the company. They said they will vote for management and its nominees at the July 17 annual meeting, and they urge all stockholders to do the same.
